claims.claim: Added a versioned typed scheduler request and immutable plan with bounded canonical closed-schema encoding. The API rejects supplied plans and witnesses as request inputs.
The scheduler independently authenticates current admission, candidate, selected reviewed population and mapping, then rechecks mutable authority roots before returning its plan.
No-source candidate planning preserves reviewed candidate obligations as outstanding without inventing prior execution, satisfaction or reuse.
Reuse requires fresh native L2-03 observations and retains original RUN, subject, EVIDENCE, provenance and raw identities without asserting target execution or acceptance.
Every reviewed obligation maps to one explicit proof unit retaining complete claims and conditions. Approved shared mappings consolidate units while distinct proof conditions remain separate.
Invalidated sources cannot yield reuse, and unknown, incomplete, failed, stale or conflicting source facts block reuse without granting acceptance PASS.
Mandatory comparisons remain represented and blocked because native BR-1 through BR-6 attestation is not established; no baseline execution or reproduction is proposed.
One core emits checkpoint and terminal projections sharing plan identity, coverage and the no-equivalent-duplicate invariant, with sealing and actual execution explicitly unasserted.
REPAIR and REMEDIATION requests fail closed for unestablished native correction lineage, including requests carrying correction locator pins.

Added isolated real-Git conformance definitions covering first candidates, reuse, mapping completeness, proof distinctions, source failures, baseline denial, stale authority, corrections and shared consumer projections using native validators.

The committed change touches only the four authorized paths, leaves legacy execution dispatch and L2 public contracts unchanged, and documents future integration gates with KA-01 NOT_ACTIVATED and G3/G6 outstanding.
